# Lonestar Pro Solutions

> Residential and commercial construction company based in Robstown, Texas, serving Corpus Christi,
> Kingsville, Robstown, Portland and the surrounding Coastal Bend since 2011.

- Phone: (361) 742-1170 (call or text)
- Hours: Monday-Friday 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday by appointment; Sunday closed
- Service area: Corpus Christi, Kingsville, Robstown, Portland and surrounding Coastal Bend, Texas
- Certified contractor with the cities of Corpus Christi, Kingsville, Robstown and Portland
- Guarantee: 100% workmanship guarantee covering their own workmanship for 60 days after completion
- Estimates: free on every job
- Financing: available through several lenders
- Languages: English and Spanish (se habla espanol)
- Crew: five in-house employees; work is not subcontracted out

## Services
Framing and new construction, remodeling and flooring, roofing, siding, decks, pergolas and sheds,
fencing, drywall and texturing, concrete and driveways, interior and exterior painting, and
ground-up commercial build-outs including facades, waterproofing and storefront finish-outs.
